The '''attack on the ''Independence''''' took place during [[Operation Skyhook]], shortly before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]], when the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' launched a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] assault on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] in the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]].

==Prelude==
After the completion of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One''-type Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] was carrying members of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]], including [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to coordinate the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] defense against the major Imperial offensive that was expected to begin. While in the [[Bestine system/Legends|Bestine system]], it came under attack from the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]''.<ref name="Xwing" /><ref name="XWOSG" />

==The battle==
Following the arrival of the ''Immortal'' and its [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the ''Independence'', including [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], were scrambled to defend the ship.<ref name="XWOSG" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force consisted of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]], splitting up and attacking the cruiser from three different directions, while [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] engaged the defending starfighters. Two of the Imperial bomber groups, [[Beta Squadron (Gelgelar)|Beta]] and [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadrons]] were quickly engaged by a pair of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearheads]] and [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], respectively. The third, [[Alpha Squadron]], made it through and began firing [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the ''Independence''. The defending starfighters were engaged with the Gunboats but eventually broke away and were able to help the ''Independence''{{'s}} gunners destroy the surviving bombers.<ref name="XWOSG" />

During the battle, Captain Farlander was confronted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], forcing him to lower the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of his X-wing. Farlander was able to resist, reactivating his shields and resuming his defense of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]].<ref name="XWOSG" />

Replacing two lost R-22s with a second wave, the ''Independence'' reached its jump point escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with its shields down but with only minimal hull damage. The remaining Rebel starfighters continued their dogfight with nearby Imperial [[Starship/Legends|ships]] before following the cruiser.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Aftermath==
By the time the ''Independence'' arrived during the night shift at [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], work had already begun to repair the damage, which was mostly confined to the shield coils and some electronics.<ref name="XWOSG" />

After witnessing the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of her [[Alderaan/Legends|homeworld]] and [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|escaping]] from Imperial custody, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] arrived on Yavin 4 with the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]]. The Alliance's analysis of the plans indicated that their best hope of defeating it lay in their starfighters, rather than their [[Capital ship/Legends|larger ships]]. Shortly after, the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] followed the Princess to the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] and the ''Independence''{{'s}} pilots and starfighters, transferred to the Yavin Base, assisted in the resulting [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle]].<ref name="XWOSG" /><ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
